notes.title: Radar Warfare - Release Date
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30782132/dcbac6494cbc38b6cb948124a676d8b809964b09.png

We are happy to announce that after 2 years Radar Warfare is almost ready for release.  We still have some things to do so we established the October 25th, 2017 as our release date.

We thank everyone that helped greenlight this game and support this journey, THANK YOU!
